about.dataFolderHint: Local SQLite settings and history. Keep this directory outside folder sync; exchange records using the separate sync directory. Changes apply after a restart.
copy.lateNightMicroPool.0: It's late. Twenty seconds on your feet — I'll whisper
copy.lateNightMicroPool.1: Your eyes want off duty too. Gaze far for a moment
copy.lateNightMicroPool.2: Quietly now: stand for 20 seconds. Don't wake the open tabs
copy.lateNightWaterPool.1: Working late? I'll keep it down: one sip
copy.lateNightWaterPool.2: However deep the night, don't leave the glass empty
copy.microPool.0: Stand for 20 seconds. Look far away 👀
copy.microPool.1: Eyes off the screen — find the farthest thing you can see
copy.microPool.2: Stand up and roll those shoulders back, twice
copy.microPool.3: Anything six meters away, for 20 seconds. That's it
copy.microPool.4: Palms over your eyes for ten seconds. Let them breathe
copy.microPool.5: Spell your name with your nose. Slowly
copy.microPool.6: March in place for ten seconds
copy.microPool.8: Walk to the end of the hall. See who else is slacking
copy.sitToastPool.0: The chair won't miss you, but your back will — Droplet
copy.sitToastPool.1: Sway for two minutes; I'll mind the screen
copy.sitToastPool.2: Stand up and let your blood rediscover your legs
copy.sitToastPool.3: The screen isn't going anywhere. Your legs are rusting — move
copy.sitToastPool.4: The way you're sitting hurts just from watching
copy.sitToastPool.5: Refill your water and take a stroll — two birds, one stone (I approve)
copy.waterPool.0: I'm Droplet — take a sip and we're reunited
copy.waterPool.1: Your glass says it's feeling a little empty
copy.waterPool.3: Bottoms up — your kidneys will thank you
copy.waterPool.4: Finish this line, then take one sip. Just one
copy.waterPool.5: Coffee is borrowed water. Time to pay it back
copy.waterPool.6: Throat a little dry? I had a feeling
copy.waterPool.7: Water first. The tangled thoughts come apart easier after

ob.intro:
I'll wait quietly at the edge of your screen, watching how long you actually work —
then, when the time comes, I'll kindly get you out of the chair.
ob.line: I'll gently remind you to drink water, move and look into the distance when it's time.
ob.pactOutro: Now, back to work. I'm watching.
ob.patHint:
Pat me, or pick me up and move me.
When rested, tap “Done”.
ob.settledBody: I'll wait quietly at the edge of your screen. See you when the next cue is due.
ob.soundHint: The chime plays once when a reminder appears; Focus mode is always silent

ob.waterTitle: How often should I nudge you to drink?
